goal: Measure spectra at 20 positions spaced 0.1 mm from X=37.0 mm to X=38.9 mm crossing a material boundary, and report the boundary position where the polystyrene-similarity change between adjacent positions is largest.

execution_summary.trajectory: Performed a 1x20 grid scan from X=37.0 to 38.9 mm. Used linear baseline subtraction and normalization in run_analysis, then computed adjacent correlations to find the sharpest transition.
execution_summary.outcome: Successfully identified the boundary crossing a polystyrene-like material.

lesson: A grid scan with a small step (0.1mm) and Pearson correlation analysis of adjacent spectra is an effective way to locate material boundaries when the exact transition point is unknown.

system_metrics.metrics: Boundary found at X=37.75 mm; Min Correlation ~0.13.
